title: Ngôi nhà gỗ
about: Round x19 (album 14), the user: "làm album và chuyển sang sáng tác album mới": sleep music in the style of Sleep in the Dark (ngu-ngon), on a less common progression of its own (template 3), slow (50 bpm), strings, pad, sub, an improvised felt tune, then box. No drums, plucked string or organ. An original piece.
